method: Chromium (Playwright) re-probe of the staff-lab mirror of Standing (site scp-jp, page scp-002-j, desktop and mobile; WSL ~/.local/state/wikijump/sigma9-probe/run-20261025-reprobe/probe-results.json) recorded the stylesheet below as CSP-blocked while the same public page on https://scp-jp.wikidot.com loads it. Direct anonymous GETs (2026-10-25) record each resource's own live response, byte count and SHA-256, including the font files the stylesheet's @font-face references through relative ../fonts/ URLs on the same origin.

observations.note: Recorded as failed 3 times with reason 'csp' in the lab-desktop probe (and likewise on mobile). The stylesheet contains one @font-face whose src URLs are relative (../fonts/cc-icons.*), i.e. font files on this same origin; every other url() in the file is one of those font references.
